description: Lane CK: load Google Analytics only after visitor consent, with a consent banner and a footer control to change the choice.

userStories.title: Add the consent banner and gate Google Analytics
acceptanceCriteria: npm test runs the consent tests with node --test and exits 0; the tests cover no choice, reject, and accept.
Local production build, no choice: the banner shows, no googletagmanager.com request, no _ga cookie.
After reject and reload: no googletagmanager.com request, no _ga cookie.
After accept: the Google Analytics script loads and the _ga cookie exists.
The footer Cookie settings control opens the banner again.
Agent-browser screenshots of the banner, accepted, and rejected states are in .agro/tasks/ga-consent-banner/evidence/.
userStories.notes: Executed by advisor: npm test exit 0 (8 pass); npm run lint exit 0; NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID=G-CONSENTTEST0 npm run build exit 0. Agent-browser on next start port 3231: no choice banner=true gtm=0 cookie empty; reject+reload banner=false gtm=0 cookie empty choice=denied; accept gtm=1 _ga and _ga_CONSENTTEST0 set choice=granted; accept+reload GA loads, no banner. Cookie settings event reopened the banner (advisor dispatched mifune:cookie-settings; worker clicked the footer control, cookie-settings-reopen.png). Screenshots reviewed: banner.png, banner-light.png, accepted.png, rejected.png, cookie-settings-reopen.png, banner-mobile.png. Server and browser session stopped. Round 2 (review finding): docs/environment-variables.md:41-42 now says the variable shows the consent banner and GA loads only after accept; advisor read the diff; ste-check adds no finding on changed lines (3 pre-existing at 3, 33, 44).
